signalValue.note: Listed on FutureCast early target board

vaultScouting.evaluation: Watched Carrollwood Day sophomore tape. Little wins with leverage and first step; polish the hands vs Power-4 OL.
vaultScouting.comparison: Little comps to Ed Oliver — same ~6-2 / 285–290 interior mold (height match, compact DT frame); then the penetrator + run-stuff motor traits from early tape (size-matched; not a Florida-alum default).
vaultScouting.projection: Little projects to develop into Florida’s DL rotation with Year-1 depth / early-down eat snaps, Year-2 compete for a starting 3-tech / shade role, and starter upside as a multi-down interior who creates negative plays if the hand counters catch the motor.
strengths: Little plays with a heavy interior motor — chases from the A/B gap and still finishes tackles outside the tackle box.
Little’s first step creates early penetration for a 6-2 / 290 body; he flashes into the backfield before OL can lock.
Little anchors vs double teams with natural leverage, clogs interior run lanes, and still generates negative plays (TFL/sack production on tape).
vaultScouting.schemeFit: Little fits an attacking interior that wants a quick shade/3-tech who can two-gap on early downs and still push the pocket.
